sources.title: 2015 Honda Odyssey Owner's Guide (U.S.)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-26. Maintenance section, pp. 122-123 (maintenance schedule notes) and p. 128 (battery).

tasks.name: Engine oil and filter
tasks.description: Change the engine oil and filter.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable interval. Not an official Honda requirement. The Owner's Guide (p. 122-123) says to change the oil at least once a year.

tasks.name: Brake fluid
tasks.description: Replace the brake fluid, which absorbs moisture over time.
tasks.sourceNote: Owner's Guide p. 122-123: replace the brake fluid every 3 years.

tasks.name: Timing belt
tasks.description: Replace the timing belt. The Owner's Guide confirms the 3.5L V6 uses a timing belt. A failed belt can cause severe engine damage.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable interval. Not an official Honda requirement. The Owner's Guide (p. 122-123) says to replace the belt every 60,000 mi if you regularly drive in very high (over 110°F) or very low (under -20°F) temperatures.

tasks.name: Transmission fluid
tasks.description: Drain and refill the automatic transmission fluid with the type your owner's guide specifies.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable interval. Not an official Honda requirement; check your owner's guide and adjust to how you drive.

tasks.name: Tire rotation
tasks.description: Rotate the tires to even out wear.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Brake inspection
tasks.description: Inspect the front and rear brakes, parking brake, and brake hoses and lines.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Engine air filter
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement. The Owner's Guide (p. 122-123) says to replace it every 15,000 mi in dusty conditions.

tasks.name: Dust and pollen (cabin) filter
tasks.description: Replace the dust and pollen filter that cleans the cabin air.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement. The Owner's Guide (p. 122-123) says to replace it every 15,000 mi if you drive mainly in urban areas with heavy soot or diesel pollution.

tasks.name: Drive belt inspection
tasks.description: Inspect the drive belt for wear and cracks.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Engine coolant
tasks.description: Replace the engine coolant. The Owner's Guide recommends Honda Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant Type 2.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, deliberately conservative, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Spark plugs
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Water pump inspection
tasks.description: Inspect the water pump when the timing belt is replaced; the Owner's Guide pairs them.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Valve clearance inspection
tasks.description: Inspect the valve clearance. The Owner's Guide also advises adjusting the valves if they are noisy.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: Idle speed inspection
tasks.sourceNote: Owner's Guide p. 122-123: inspect idle speed every 160,000 miles.

tasks.name: Battery terminal check
tasks.description: Check the battery terminals for corrosion.
tasks.sourceNote: Owner's Guide p. 128: check the battery terminals for corrosion monthly.

tasks.name: Wiper blades
tasks.description: Replace the front and rear wiper blade rubber when it streaks or deteriorates.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.

tasks.name: General inspection
tasks.description: Inspect steering (tie rod ends, gearbox, boots), suspension, driveshaft boots, exhaust, fuel lines, and fluid levels.
tasks.sourceNote: Community-suggested, editable value. Not an official Honda requirement.
